provenance.source: production Neon, read-only SELECT on brief_runs / brief_stories / articles / sources
provenance.stripped: no article body text or event_summary_points; only ids, titles, urls, publish dates, source ids/names, and (for 3 clusters) the LLM-extracted metadata tags that generateSearchText consumes
provenance.notes: clusters = brief_stories rows of the run (post-merge, post-cap article sets). judge.title = the stored story title; titles that are a bare dominant entity (Rwanda, Trump) are modelled as NO_EVENT with empty title. judge.event is not persisted in production, left empty. prodImportance = the importance stored in production for that block.
